{"model": "claude-agentsight-mock", "max_tokens": 64, "messages": [{"role": "assistant", "content": "During 09:00-18:00 on weekdays, block WeChat and video-streaming apps for the R&D group (10.1.5.0/24). Outside those hours, allow them.

Site notes: this firewall has no DPI engine; application signatures are the destination/port sets in /etc/nb/app-signatures.json. R&D hosts are on 10.1.5.0/24 behind eth1 (gateway 10.1.5.1). nftables supports `meta hour` and `meta day`.
PLAN:
nft insert rule inet filter forward meta day '{1-5}' meta hour '"09:00"-"18:00"' ip saddr 10.1.5.0/24 ip daddr '{198.51.100.20, 198.51.100.21}' drop"}]}
